title: Valérie
writer: John Dunning, André Link, Richard Sadler
actors: Danielle Ouimet, Guy Godin, Andrée Flamand
plot: A seminal Quebec erotic film about a curious girl who leaves her convent to explore the Montréal hippy scene, becomes a prostitute and meets her true love who doesn't know she's a hooker, that started erotic film genre in Canada.
